criteria.requirement: Add Validator.validate_result(document, schema=None, *, update=False, normalize=True) and frozen-shell cerberus.result.ValidationResult(valid, document, errors, completed=True). Run actual validation and deep-copy normalized document plus the configured error_handler output so later calls and result-content mutations cannot overwrite validator/other results. Preserve validate/validated bool/None interfaces and normalization/update flags. Unexpected exceptions propagate without publishing a completed result; document that nested snapshot contents are editable and the validator is not made thread safe.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
